paragraphs.text: 人生看板 · 把 markdown 日志折成五张卡（健康/任务/资产/情绪/书架）。Local-only life dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
# dsh-lifeboard
> Fold the everyday traces you already keep in markdown — **health · tasks · assets · mood · bookshe

lf** — into one read-only dashboard.
> No new database, no cloud, and the finance card stays unread
until you ask for it.
**English** · 中文
> The banner above is an interface illustration rendered from the built-in demo data. The screenshot
below is the real plugin in the DSH sidebar.
> Screenshot uses built-in demo data (a fictional person), not real records.
## What it does
You log your weight in a daily note, your todos in a TODO file, your assets in a spreadsheet — and n
one of it ever becomes something you can read at a glance.
This plugin adds nothing new. It **reads** the markdown and TSV you already write, folds them into f
ive cards, and docks them in the DSH sidebar. It does not modify your files; the only two write acti
ons are "tick a task" and "check in a mood", and both require a click from you.
**How it differs**

| | Typical plugins | This one |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Data source | You migrate data into their store | R

eads the markdown you **already write** |
| Scope | One domain (tasks / usage / health) | Five domai

ns in one panel |
| Privacy | Everything read by default | Assets and spending stay **unread** until

you click 👁 |
| Onboarding | Configure first, see later | Ships with demo data — install and look |
## The five cards

| Card | Reads | Shows |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 🩺 **Health** | The health table plus sleep/exercise section
s of each daily note | Weight with delta, 7-day sparkline, body fat / visceral fat / bone mineral /

heart rate / sleep / exercise, protein progress ring |
| 📋 **Tasks** | `- [ ]` lines in your TODO fi

le | Sorted by due date, overdue in red, `#tag` split into work/life; tick or postpone inline |
| 💼

**Assets** | Asset snapshot TSV | SVG donut by category, top-5 holdings, this month's spending |
| 🧠
**Mood · Exercise** | Mood and exercise sections of the log | 7-day dots, streak, latest mood; four

one-click check-in buttons |
| 📚 **Bookshelf** | `.md` files under the bookshelf folder | Covers; c
lick a book to pull a random excerpt |

All optional. Edit in **Settings → Lifeboard**, or set defaults in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`

## Privacy
- **Nothing leaves the machine**: the plugin only registers local HTTP routes (`/api/lifeboard/*`) a

nd contacts no third-party service
- **Sensitive cards are opt-in**: assets and spending are request

ed from the host only after you click 👁, and rendered locally
- **`private/` is never scanned**: not

hing is read unless you configure the path
- **No data in the package**: the tarball contains code,
generated demo covers, and text only
## Compatibility

- Tested on `dsh 0.2.1-rc.2` – `0.2.2-rc.1`
- Depends on two host capabilities: `connection.fetch.re

gister` (local routes) and client `slots` (sidebar, main panel, settings section)
- If cards disappe
ar after a kernel upgrade, check the DSH log for `lifeboard: ... route unavailable`
### 关于安全扫描的两个 Warning
dsh.so 的扫描器会报两条 Warning，都是**设计如此**，不是漏洞：

| Warning | 是什么 | 边界 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `Child process module usage`（`spawn('open', [abs])`） | 点卡片上的「
源」跳转时，用系统默认程序打开对应文件 | 路径必须落在配置的 vault 内（防穿越）；**只允许** `.md/.markdown/.tsv/.json/.txt/.csv`；只开文件不开目录；单

文件 ≤5 MB；参数数组形式，不经 shell |
| 写文件到 `_assistant/.backup/` | 任务勾选/延期前先备份 TODO | 只在 TODO 同目录下写 `.bak`，保留

形式，不经 shell |
| 写文件到 `_assistant/.backup/` | 任务勾选/延期前先备份 TODO | 只在 TODO 同目录下写 `.bak`，保留最近 5 份；不做删除 |
插件没有任何网络请求；写操作只有三个，且都要你在界面上手点（勾任务、延期、情绪打卡）。
### 隐私

- **数据不出本机**：插件只注册本机 HTTP 路由（`/api/lifeboard/*`），不请求任何第三方服务
- **敏感卡默认不读**：资产与支出要点 👁 才向宿主请求，且只在本机渲染
-

**`private/` 不主动扫**：路径由你显式配置，不配就不读
- **包里没有数据**：安装包只有代码、生成式示例封面与文案
### 兼容性

- 已测：`dsh 0.2.1-rc.2` ~ `0.2.2-rc.1`
- 依赖宿主两个能力：`connection.fetch.register`（本机路由）、客户端 `slots`（侧边栏 +

主面板 + 设置小节）
- 内核升级后若卡片不显示，先看 DSH 日志有没有 `lifeboard: ... route unavailable`
